# Koduvayur Ratholsavam 2026

> Official digital festival notice and schedule for Koduvayur Ratholsavam 2026 (December 24–25, 2026 / 1202 Dhanu 09, 10) at Sree Visalakshy Sametha Sree Viswanatha Swamy Temple, Koduvayur Keralapuram Agraharam, Palakkad, Kerala, India.

## Official Resources & Navigation
- [Koduvayur Ratholsavam 2026 Official Website](https://koduvayur.in/): Complete interactive schedule, committee roster, contribution details, and festival film.
- [Official 2026 Festival Notice (PDF)](https://koduvayur.in/pdf/RAD2026.pdf): Printable English and Malayalam festival brochure and ritual timings.
- [Festival Schedule (Dec 04 – Dec 23)](https://koduvayur.in/#festival-schedule): Muhurthakaal, Vasthuhomam, Dhwajarohanam, and six days of Utsavam Vahanam processions.
- [Temple Special Events](https://koduvayur.in/#temple-special-events): Rudra Ekadashi, Sri Subramanya Homam, Mahapradosham, Thiru Kalyanam, Nadaswara Kacheri, and Ganga Arathi.
- [Cultural Dance Events](https://koduvayur.in/#cultural-dance-events): Evening devotional dance and Thiruvathirakali performances (Dec 18–21).
- [Ratholsavam Chariot Days (Dec 24 & 25)](https://koduvayur.in/#ratholsavam-chariot-days): Day One and Day Two sacred chariot procession timings across Koduvayur Agraharam.
- [Mega Entertainment Events](https://koduvayur.in/#mega-entertainment-events): Gokula Street Bandset, Panchari Melam, and Pandi Melam ensembles.
- [Post-Festival Events (Dec 26 – Dec 28)](https://koduvayur.in/#post-festival-events): Pallakku Kacheri, Kulatheru, Manjal Neerattu, Dhwajavarohanam, and Mahabhishekam.
- [XML Sitemap](https://koduvayur.in/sitemap.xml): Search and agent index for koduvayur.in.
- [Brandsta Interactive](https://brandsta.in/): Official digital branding and web engineering partner.

## Temple & Vedic Heritage
- Temple Administration: Sree Viswanatha Swamy Temple (Malabar Devaswom Board)
- Location: Koduvayur Keralapuram Agraharam, Koduvayur, Palakkad, Kerala 678501, India (10.6844, 76.6470)

Koduvayur Keralapuram Agraharam is a historic Vedic village in Palakkad, Kerala, deeply connected to the Thillai Nataraja Temple in Chidambaram, Tamil Nadu. Skilled Vedic scholars and priests (Deekshidars) migrated from Chidambaram to Koduvayur, bringing rich yaga, yagna, and temple festival traditions.

The presiding west-facing deity, Sree Viswanatha Swamy (a Kshatriya Shiva Linga originally brought from Kasi), is worshipped alongside consorts Sree Visalakshy and Meenakshi, as well as Ganesha, Subramania Swamy, Suryanarayanan, Dakshinamurthy, two Nandikeshwaras, eight Dikpalakas, and Chandikeswara.

### Seven Unique Aspects of Koduvayur Ratholsavam
1. Longest Procession Circuit: Spans approximately 1.5 miles through the village without retracing its path.
2. Chidambaram-Inspired Layout: The Temple and Keralapuram Agraharam mirror the symbolic layout of Chidambaram.
3. Sacred Pond Ritual: Holy ablution water used for the deities is poured into the temple pond, revered with the sanctity of the Ganges.
4. Banana Showers (Pazhameru): Devotees generously shower bananas onto the moving temple chariots as offerings.
5. Three Soma Yagams: Historically conducted by Sri Vishwanatha Deekshidar, Sri Vaidyalinga Deekshidar, and Sri Chidambara Deekshidar.
6. Living Vedic Village: Centuries of unbroken Vedaparayanam and Vedic scholarship echo across the Agraharam.
7. Pranavam (Om) Chariot Path: The three decorated temple chariots—carrying Lord Ganesha, Lord Subramania Swamy with Valli and Devasena, and Sree Visalakshy Sametha Sree Viswanatha Swamy—follow an Om-shaped sacred circuit.

## 2026 Festival & Ritual Schedule
Daily Vedaparayanam (morning and evening) and Rudrabhishekam followed by Deeparadhana (from 9:00 AM) are held at the Sree Viswanatha Swamy Temple premises from December 18 to December 23, 2026.

- December 4, 2026 (Friday): 8:00 AM – 9:00 AM — Muhurthakaal Ceremony.
- December 17, 2026 (Thursday): 11:00 PM — Vasthuhomam followed by Gramasanthi.
- December 18, 2026 (Friday · Utsavam Day 1): 7:15 AM – 8:30 AM — Dhwajarohanam; 5:45 PM – 8:30 PM — Dance Performances (Kalaivani Group, Sivasakthi Group & Natyakalakshetra Group); 9:30 PM — Kamadhenu Vahanam Procession.
- December 19, 2026 (Saturday · Utsavam Day 2): 8:00 AM — Rudra Ekadashi; 5:45 PM – 8:30 PM — Dance Performances (Devi Group, Souparnika Nrithakalalayam & Sivasakthi Nrithakalalayam); 9:30 PM — Bootha Vahanam Procession.
- December 20, 2026 (Sunday · Utsavam Day 3): 8:00 AM — Sri Subramanya Homam; 5:45 PM – 8:30 PM — Dance Performances (Mazhamariyamman Group, Krishnapriya Nandan & Chilanka Dance Academy); 9:30 PM — Kuthira Vahanam Procession.
- December 21, 2026 (Monday · Utsavam Day 4): 3:00 PM — Mahapradosham; 5:45 PM – 8:30 PM — Thiruvathirakali Dance Performances (Natyajyothi Nrithakalalayam, Kausthubham Group & Layam Group); 9:30 PM — Kailasam Vahanam Procession.
- December 22, 2026 (Tuesday · Utsavam Day 5): 8:00 AM — Shiva Parvathi Thiru Kalyanam (Erode Rajamani Bhagavathar & Party); 7:00 PM — Bandset at Gokula Street (Ragadeepam Mundathikode, organized by Team Altharakoottam); 10:30 PM — Rishaba Vahanam Procession & Special Nadaswara Kacheri (Pazhani Manikandan, Pazhani Sivakumar & Party).
- December 23, 2026 (Wednesday · Utsavam Day 6): 7:30 PM — Ganga Arathi at Viswanatha Swamy Temple Pond; 9:00 PM — Aana Vahanam Procession.
- December 24, 2026 (Thursday · Ratholsavam Day 1 / First Chariot Day):
  - 1:30 AM: Poornabhishekam begins
  - 5:00 AM – 6:00 AM: Ardhra Darshanam, Radha Pooja, Rakshadharanam, Yathradanam
  - 6:30 AM – 7:15 AM: Radharohanam (Ascent of Deities onto the Three Chariots)
  - 8:30 AM: Thirumanjanam Procession with Elephant & Panchavadhyam
  - 2:00 PM: Radham Grama Pradakshinam (Chariot Procession begins)
  - 6:30 PM: Bhajana, Deeparadhana, Kramarchana
  - 7:00 PM: Panchari Melam led by Pazhuvil Raghu Marar from Corner Street Mahaganapathy Temple
- December 25, 2026 (Friday · Ratholsavam Day 2 / Second Chariot Day):
  - 7:30 AM: Pooja & Deeparadhana for Chariot Deities in Gokula Street
  - 12:00 PM: Radham Gramam Procession resumes
  - 8:00 PM: Fireworks (Karimarunnu Prayogam)
  - 8:15 PM: Bhajana, Avathara, Deeparadhana
  - 11:00 PM: Pandi Melam led by Mela Kalaratnam Kizhakkoot Aniyan Marar and 101+ percussionists
- December 26, 2026 (Saturday): 2:30 AM — Pallakku Kacheri; 4:00 AM — Kulatheru followed by Mounavritham.
- December 27, 2026 (Sunday): 9:00 AM — Manjal Neerattu; 7:00 PM — Dhwajavarohanam.
- December 28, 2026 (Monday): 9:00 AM — Mahabhishekam.
